At a desktop viewport, both sample reports retain their existing two-column orientation layout and no material visual regression is observed.

requirement.summary: Implement the separately selected generated-report narrow-width follow-up. Add presentation-only CSS containment to the canonical HTML report generator so grid children and panels can shrink within a phone viewport while existing nowrap commands scroll inside their own command region. Synchronize that exact presentation change into the protected English and Chinese sanitized illustrative 0.3.0rc1 sample reports, update only the current expected hashes, preserve historical hash evidence, and add deterministic regression coverage. Keep report data, findings, wording, release identity, product behavior, and authority semantics unchanged. This task prepares and validates local repository changes only and grants no commit, push, publication, release, deployment, or external-write authority.

items: Changing protected sample bytes without exact human admission would violate the repository's artifact boundary.
A broad CSS selector could conceal content or regress the desktop report layout.
Manual synchronization could accidentally change report semantics, counts, wording, links, or version identity.
Updating every old hash occurrence would rewrite historical evidence instead of updating only current truth.
The dirty worktree contains prior-task changes that must remain preserved and clearly outside this task's ownership.
A local fix could be mistaken for a published correction unless the publication boundary remains explicit.
